description: This file defines the CampaignLog class, which manages the campaign logging data within the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties corresponding to database fields, methods for data retrieval and related name resolution, and logic for interfacing with other modules such as Accounts, Contacts, Leads, and email marketing.

classes.name: CampaignLog
classes.description: Represents a log entry for campaign activities, providing methods to retrieve associated records, email addresses, and related entity names within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for list view display, including recipient name, email, and related marketing name.

methods.name: retrieve_email_address
methods.description: Fetches the primary email address associated with a given target ID.

methods.name: get_related_name
methods.description: Returns the display name for related records based on type and ID, such as contacts, accounts, leads, or campaign trackers.
